_comment: Core Keeper versions this tool has been checked against.
The mod reaches into the game's own types: PlayerController's sprite sheet layers,
layout. A game update is free to move any of those, so the tool refuses to run against a
version nobody has checked rather than writing files that might do nothing, or worse.
Entries are matched on the leading major.minor.patch, which is the same granularity the
game itself uses (Manager.versionRegex is ^(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)). The build suffix that
follows, such as .5-8be0, changes far more often than anything the mod depends on.
Widening this list is the whole job of supporting a new game version: verify the layout
with scripts/generate-layout.ps1 and the part boxes with scripts/generate-parts-layout.ps1,
